Return History
Rules
  1. Each month on the 1st, your return is calculated from your qualified loss in the last 3 full months.
  2. Monthly Return = 3-Month Qualified Loss ÷ 60, paid as 4 Weekly Returns on the first 4 Fridays of the month.
  3. Unclaimed Weekly Returns accumulate (up to 4). When a 5th arrives, it replaces the oldest one.
  4. To claim, deposit at least 10% of the amount you are claiming.
  5. Claim 4 Weekly Returns (or reach the required VIP level) to unlock Advance Bonus. Claim 8 to unlock Super Advance. Unlocked features become available from the next monthly cycle.
  6. Advance Bonus: get your next Weekly Return early. Super Advance: get all remaining Weekly Returns of this month early. A 10% deposit is required.
  7. Advanced amounts must be repaid in full from your available balance. Until repaid, you cannot claim returns or advance again. Your account is otherwise unaffected.
  8. All rewards carry a 1x wagering requirement on (deposit + reward).
演示场景
模拟其他入口充值
模拟用户在 789Bingo 大厅等其他入口充值到账（不经过活动页 Deposit）。到账金额按「从早到晚」自动计入尚未满足充值要求的期数：先可领取的期数，再可预支的期数。超出部分不计入后续期数。
